title: One Morning in Hiroshima
title_yt: One Morning in Hiroshima, 1945: Would You Have Survived?
description:
August 6, 1945. You wake up in Hiroshima to a clear blue sky. Minute by minute, from the 7:09 siren to the days after: where were you standing at 8:15, and would you have survived?

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: City of Hiroshima (The Realities of the Atomic Bombing); Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum; Hiroshima Peace Media Center (Chugoku Shimbun); Radiation Effects Research Foundation; US National Park Service.

Visuals and narration are AI-generated, based on historical accounts. Told with respect for the victims and survivors.

#Hiroshima #History #POV

scenes.text: One hour from now, this city will be gone. And nobody here knows it.
scenes.prompt: wide view over a Japanese city of low wooden houses and rivers on a bright summer morning, tiled roofs, a domed brick building by the river, clear blue sky, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: slow aerial drift over a quiet city of wooden houses and rivers in bright morning light, birds fly past, gentle haze

scenes.text: Thirty-seven people are arriving for work in a concrete building beside the river. In a few minutes, one of them will walk down to the basement to look for some papers.
scenes.prompt: office workers in 1940s Japanese clothing entering a three-story concrete building beside a river bridge, morning light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Remember him. Because what he does next is the difference between everyone, and one.
scenes.prompt: close-up of a middle-aged Japanese office clerk in a white shirt holding a folder at the top of a dark stairway, 1940s, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a middle-aged office clerk holding a folder turns and slowly walks down a dark concrete stairway, soft light from above

scenes.text: It's Monday, August sixth, nineteen forty-five. You're in Hiroshima. The sky is perfectly clear.
scenes.prompt: street-level view of a 1940s Japanese street with a streetcar, cyclists and pedestrians in summer clothes, clear blue sky, morning, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a 1940s streetcar rolls slowly down a Japanese street, cyclists and pedestrians pass, morning sunlight, gentle camera push forward

scenes.text: Today you'll live this morning minute by minute. And by the end of this video, you'll know whether you would have survived it.
scenes.prompt: first-person view walking across a wooden-railed bridge over a wide calm river toward a city of low houses, morning sun, 1940s, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: At nine minutes past seven, the air raid siren starts to wail.
scenes.prompt: air raid siren loudspeaker on a wooden pole above tiled roofs, clear morning sky, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: You've heard it a hundred times. Tokyo has burned. Osaka has burned. Sixty Japanese cities have been firebombed.
scenes.prompt: a Japanese family in 1940s clothing looking up at the sky from the doorway of a wooden house, worried, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: But not Hiroshima. For some reason, the bombers always pass it by. People here have started to wonder why.
scenes.prompt: peaceful Japanese street of wooden shops with paper lanterns and noren curtains, people chatting, morning, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: High above, a single silver plane crosses the sky. It drops nothing. It's a weather plane, checking the clouds over the city.
scenes.prompt: a single tiny silver B-29 airplane very high in a clear blue sky leaving a thin white trail, seen from the ground, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a tiny silver airplane very high in a clear blue sky slowly crosses the frame leaving a thin white trail, seen from the ground

scenes.text: And the sky is clear. That report has just sealed the fate of everyone around you.
scenes.prompt: clear blue summer sky over tiled Japanese rooftops and a distant green mountain, morning, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: At seven thirty-one, the all-clear sounds. People climb out of the shelters, stretch, and go back to their morning.
scenes.prompt: people in 1940s Japanese clothing climbing out of a small earthen backyard air raid shelter, relieved, morning light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Breakfast is small. Rice mixed with barley, maybe a little pickled radish. The war has made everyone thin.
scenes.prompt: a simple 1940s Japanese breakfast on a low wooden table, small bowls of rice and pickles, tatami room, morning light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: By eight o'clock, around three hundred and fifty thousand people are in Hiroshima.
scenes.prompt: crowded 1940s Japanese city street in the morning, pedestrians, bicycles and a streetcar, wooden buildings, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Soldiers do their morning exercises on the parade ground near the castle.
scenes.prompt: rows of Japanese soldiers doing morning calisthenics on a parade ground with a traditional castle tower behind, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Streetcars rattle through the center, packed with commuters. Many of the drivers are teenage girls, because the men are at war.
scenes.prompt: a teenage Japanese girl in a uniform and cap driving a crowded 1940s streetcar, seen from inside, morning light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: inside a crowded 1940s streetcar, a teenage girl in uniform and cap drives, passengers sway gently, sunlight flickers through the windows

scenes.text: And in the streets, thousands of schoolchildren are already at work.
scenes.prompt: large group of Japanese schoolchildren in 1940s school uniforms and work clothes walking down a street with tools, morning, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: They're twelve, thirteen, fourteen years old. Their job is to tear down houses, to make wide gaps that will stop fires from spreading when the bombers finally come.
scenes.prompt: Japanese schoolchildren pulling ropes to tear down an old wooden house in a street, dust rising, 1945, morning sun, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: schoolchildren in 1940s work clothes pull on ropes together to tear down an old wooden house, dust rises, morning sun

scenes.text: More than nine thousand students are doing this today. Outdoors. In short sleeves. Under an open sky.
scenes.prompt: schoolgirls in white blouses and work trousers carrying roof tiles in a line under a bright summer sky, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: In the concrete building by the river, the clerk you met is at his desk. His name is Eizo Nomura. He's forty-seven.
scenes.prompt: a middle-aged Japanese clerk in a white shirt sitting at a wooden desk covered in papers in a 1940s office, window light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: He notices that some documents are missing. They must be downstairs. He stands up.
scenes.prompt: a 1940s Japanese office clerk standing up from his desk and looking toward a door, colleagues working around him, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Three kilometers away, a young ship engineer named Tsutomu Yamaguchi is walking to the shipyard. It's the last day of his business trip. Tomorrow, he goes home to Nagasaki.
scenes.prompt: a young Japanese man in a 1940s work suit and cap walking along a road beside potato fields toward a shipyard, morning sun, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Now, here's your choice, and you don't even know you're making it. Where are you standing at eight fifteen? Outside, or inside? Wood, or concrete? Near the center, or far?
scenes.prompt: split view feeling of a Japanese street: a wooden house on one side and a solid concrete bank building on the other, people walking between, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: A few people look up. Three planes, very high. No siren this time. Three planes aren't a raid.
scenes.prompt: people on a 1940s Japanese street shading their eyes and looking up at the bright sky, curious, not afraid, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: One of them is called the Enola Gay. It took off from the island of Tinian, six hours ago.
scenes.prompt: a silver B-29 bomber flying high above scattered clouds and a coastline far below, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: At eight fifteen, a single bomb falls from it. It drops for forty-three seconds.
scenes.prompt: view straight down from very high altitude onto a city spread across a river delta with seven river branches, clear day, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: It's aimed at a T-shaped bridge in the heart of the city. It drifts a little, and bursts about six hundred meters above a small hospital instead.
scenes.prompt: a distinctive T-shaped bridge over a river junction in a 1940s Japanese city, seen from above, morning, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: First comes the light. A silent flash, brighter than anything you have ever seen. Survivors will call it pika. The flash.
scenes.prompt: blinding white light flooding a Japanese street, long sharp shadows of people and bicycles, overexposed, silent, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a blinding white light suddenly floods the street, shadows stretch long and sharp, everything overexposes to white

scenes.text: With it comes heat. For a few seconds, the ground beneath the fireball is hotter than molten iron.
scenes.prompt: roof tiles and a stone wall glowing in intense white-orange light, heat shimmer, no people, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: People as far as three and a half kilometers away feel their skin burn.
scenes.prompt: a distant intense glow over the rooftops of a Japanese city seen from a hillside road, people shielding their faces, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Then the blast. A wall of air moving faster than sound. Almost every building within two kilometers is flattened or set on fire.
scenes.prompt: a shock wave of dust racing down a street of wooden houses, roof tiles flying, debris in the air, no people, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a wall of dust and debris rushes down a street of wooden houses, roof tiles fly, the camera shakes violently

scenes.text: Wooden houses simply fold. And then, darkness. The dust is so thick that morning turns to night.
scenes.prompt: collapsed wooden houses under a dark brown sky thick with dust, dim red sun barely visible, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Above the city, a cloud climbs higher and higher into the sky.
scenes.prompt: a towering mushroom-shaped cloud rising over a distant city seen from far across a bay, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a towering cloud slowly rises and billows higher over a distant city seen from across a bay, smoke rolling upward

scenes.text: Eizo Nomura is in the basement, reaching for his documents, when the lights go out.
scenes.prompt: a dark concrete basement storeroom with shelves of paper files, a man's hand reaching for a folder, a single bulb, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: in a dim concrete basement a man reaches for a folder on a shelf, the single light bulb flickers and goes out, dust falls from the ceiling

scenes.text: He hears a huge roar. Something hits his head. He's sure the building has taken a direct hit.
scenes.prompt: dust and small debris falling from the ceiling of a pitch dark concrete basement, a faint shaft of light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: He is one hundred and seventy meters from the center of the explosion. Closer than any other person who will live to tell about it.
scenes.prompt: a three-story concrete building standing damaged but upright among flattened ruins beside a river, smoke, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: He feels his way up the stairs in the dark. The world he walks out into is not the one he left.
scenes.prompt: a man's silhouette climbing a concrete stairway toward a dim smoky doorway, rubble on the steps, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a man's silhouette slowly climbs a rubble-covered concrete stairway toward a dim smoky doorway, dust drifting in the light

scenes.text: The whole neighborhood is gone. Shops, houses, temples. Fire is rising everywhere.
scenes.prompt: a flattened district of smoking rubble and broken tiles with fires starting, a river and a ruined dome beyond, dark sky, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Thirty-seven people came to work in his building this morning. He is the only one who survives.
scenes.prompt: an empty ruined office room with overturned desks and scattered papers, smoke drifting through broken windows, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: The only difference between him and the others was one floor of concrete.
scenes.prompt: thick cracked concrete ceiling of a basement seen from below, dust in a beam of light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: If you're still alive, you have a new problem. The city is catching fire. All of it, all at once.
scenes.prompt: fires spreading across collapsed wooden houses under a dark smoky sky, embers in the air, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: fires spread quickly across collapsed wooden houses, flames flicker, embers swirl upward into a dark smoky sky

scenes.text: Thousands of small fires join into one. The wind begins to blow toward the center, feeding it.
scenes.prompt: a huge wall of flame and smoke over a ruined city seen from a river bank, wind blowing sparks, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: So here is the next choice. You can stay and search the ruins for your family. Or you can walk away, right now, toward the hills.
scenes.prompt: a person standing in a rubble-strewn street looking back at burning ruins, hills visible in the distance the other way, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Many stay. They dig. They call out names. And the fire closes in around them.
scenes.prompt: silhouettes of people searching through the rubble of a collapsed house, smoke and orange glow behind them, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: The ones who live are mostly the ones who move. Out toward the edges. Toward the rivers, the parks, the hills.
scenes.prompt: a long line of people walking away along a road out of a smoking city toward green hills, seen from behind, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a long line of people walks slowly away along a road toward green hills, smoke drifts across the sky behind them, seen from behind

scenes.text: Hiroshima is built on seven rivers. Thousands crowd onto the banks and into the water, to escape the heat.
scenes.prompt: crowds of people gathered on the stone steps of a wide river bank under a smoky orange sky, seen from a distance, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Then, about half an hour after the flash, it begins to rain. Thick, dark, heavy drops. Black rain.
scenes.prompt: heavy dark rain falling on a ruined street, black streaks running down a white wall, gloomy sky, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: heavy dark rain falls on a ruined street, black streaks run down a white plaster wall, puddles ripple

scenes.text: People are desperately thirsty. Some open their mouths to the sky.
scenes.prompt: a hand holding a metal cup out into dark falling rain, ruined street behind, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Nobody knows that the rain is carrying soot, ash, and radioactive dust back down on top of them.
scenes.prompt: dark rainwater pooling among broken roof tiles and ash, close-up, ripples, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Three kilometers from the center, Tsutomu Yamaguchi sees the plane, and a small shape falling beneath a parachute.
scenes.prompt: a young Japanese man in a work suit on a country road looking up at a bright sky, potato fields around him, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Then the sky turns white. He dives into a ditch, the way he was trained.
scenes.prompt: a potato field and an irrigation ditch washed in blinding white light, a man throwing himself to the ground, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: The blast lifts him off the ground and throws him into the field. When he opens his eyes, it's dark, and his arms and face are burned.
scenes.prompt: a dark dusty field with flattened plants under a brown sky, a man's cap lying on the ground, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: But he's alive. He was far enough. He spends the night in a shelter, and the next morning he does the only thing he can think of. He goes home.
scenes.prompt: a crowded 1940s steam train at a damaged station platform with tired passengers, smoke in the sky, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Home is Nagasaki. He arrives on August eighth. On the morning of the ninth, bandaged, he reports to his office.
scenes.prompt: a bandaged young Japanese man standing in a 1940s office talking to a skeptical older boss, window behind them, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: He's telling his boss that a single bomb destroyed an entire city. His boss tells him that's impossible.
scenes.prompt: an older Japanese manager in a 1940s suit shaking his head at a desk, bright window behind him, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: And at that moment, the window behind them fills with white light.
scenes.prompt: an office window flooding with intense white light, silhouettes of two men turning toward it, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Tsutomu Yamaguchi survives that one too. He lives to be ninety-three.
scenes.prompt: an elderly Japanese man sitting peacefully in a garden holding a cup of tea, soft afternoon light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: By evening, Hiroshima has stopped burning, mostly because there is nothing left to burn.
scenes.prompt: a vast plain of smoking ruins at dusk with a few concrete shells standing, red sky, rivers reflecting light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: slow aerial drift over a vast plain of smoking ruins at dusk, a few concrete shells standing, thin smoke rising, red sky

scenes.text: From the hills, the city glows red through the night.
scenes.prompt: people sitting on a dark hillside at night looking down at a red glowing plain below, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Schools and temples on the outskirts fill with the injured. There are almost no doctors. Most of the city's hospitals are gone.
scenes.prompt: a crowded school hall turned into an aid station, people resting on straw mats, a nurse with a lantern, 1945, respectful, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: And then something begins that no one can explain. People who seemed unhurt start to fall ill. Fever. Weakness. Their hair comes out in their hands.
scenes.prompt: a tired woman sitting on a straw mat in a dim room looking at a comb in her hand, soft window light, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: No one in Hiroshima has ever heard the word radiation. Doctors write down what they see, and call it atomic bomb disease.
scenes.prompt: a Japanese doctor in a white coat writing notes by lamplight beside a window in a damaged hospital, 1945, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: And yet, three days after the bomb, on August ninth, a sound comes back to the ruined city.
scenes.prompt: a single streetcar track running through a flat field of rubble under a hazy sky, wires overhead, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: A streetcar. One short line, running again through the ashes. Driven by the same teenage girls.
scenes.prompt: a 1940s streetcar moving slowly along tracks through a field of ruins, a girl in a cap at the controls, hazy light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: a single 1940s streetcar moves slowly along tracks through a wide field of ruins, hazy sunlight, dust drifting

scenes.text: People stop in the rubble and stare. Some of them cry. Something still works.
scenes.prompt: survivors standing among ruins watching a streetcar pass, seen from behind, soft morning haze, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Today, a modern city of more than a million people stands on the same seven rivers.
scenes.prompt: modern city skyline with rivers and bridges at sunrise, green parks, present day, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: But at its center, one ruin has been left exactly as it was. A hall with a skeleton dome. The bomb burst almost directly above it, and so its walls stayed standing.
scenes.prompt: the ruined brick shell of a hall with a bare steel dome frame beside a calm river, trees, blue sky, present day, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: In the museum nearby, there's a wristwatch. Its hands stopped at eight fifteen.
scenes.prompt: an old damaged wristwatch with hands at 8:15 in a museum display case, soft spotlight, close-up, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: And a set of stone steps from the front of a bank, with a dark shape on them. The shadow of someone who was sitting there, waiting for the doors to open.
scenes.prompt: old stone steps with a faint dark shadow shape on them in a dim museum display, respectful, soft light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Nobody knows the exact toll. The most careful estimates say between ninety thousand and one hundred and sixty-six thousand people had died by the end of that year.
scenes.prompt: thousands of paper lanterns floating on a river at dusk in front of a ruined dome, present day, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: hundreds of glowing paper lanterns float slowly down a river at dusk, reflections shimmer on the water, a ruined dome in the background

scenes.text: Of the nine thousand students tearing down houses that morning, nearly two thirds never came home.
scenes.prompt: rows of small old school caps and lunch boxes in a museum display case, soft light, respectful, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: So. Would you have survived?
scenes.prompt: the ruined steel-frame dome against a clear blue sky, seen from below, present day, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: It was never about being brave, or smart, or fast. It was about where you happened to be standing at eight fifteen.
scenes.prompt: an empty 1940s Japanese street intersection with long morning shadows, clock on a building, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Outdoors, within a kilometer of the center, almost no one lived.
scenes.prompt: an open wide street in a 1940s Japanese city center under a bright sky, seen from above, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Behind thick concrete, your chances rose. A handful of people survived within five hundred meters, nearly all of them inside heavy buildings or basements.
scenes.prompt: massive concrete wall and doorway of a 1940s bank building, strong shadows, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Three kilometers out, like Yamaguchi, most people lived, if they moved away from the fires and didn't drink the rain.
scenes.prompt: a country road leading away from a distant smoky city toward green hills, clear sky ahead, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: And one man lived at a hundred and seventy meters, because at the right moment, he went downstairs to look for some papers.
scenes.prompt: a single folder of old papers lying on a concrete step in a shaft of light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
scenes.motion: dust drifts slowly through a shaft of light falling on a folder of old papers lying on a concrete step, slow camera push in

scenes.text: He lived until nineteen eighty-two, and spent years writing down the names of the thirty-six who didn't.
scenes.prompt: an elderly Japanese man writing carefully at a desk by a window, soft light, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate

scenes.text: Where would you have been standing that morning? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.prompt: paper lanterns floating on a dark river at night, a ruined dome softly lit in the background, peaceful, Hiroshima Japan, summer 1945, period-accurate
